messages:
maria_sales: Varuna sent an updated RFP. They want a capability matrix + explicit KMS/HSM statements + final POC schedule by tomorrow 11am PT. Can we turn this around?

devin_se: 2-week POC looks doable: week1 dedicated GPU benchmarks + week2 integration with Private. Kickoff Mon, perf report day 5, integration demos day 10. Need access details from their infra team.

ashley_product: We'll include canary rollout steps and failure thresholds. Which model families are in scope?

maria_sales: They listed redwood-7b and redwood-14b, plus asking about quantized 8-bit for cost tests.

ravi_security: KMS/HSM Qs: short answers — customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated and Private; Private supports on-prem HSM. Hosted supports CMEK references but not full HSM custody. I'll draft RFP language.

maria_sales: Please draft exact wording we can paste into the response.

ravi_security: Draft text: "Customer-managed keys are supported for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Private (VPC or on-prem) customers may integrate their own HSM or cloud KMS; secret key material can be configured to remain under customer control. For Hosted API we support customer-managed encryption key references (CMEK) where cloud provider support exists; hosted endpoints do not provide Redwood-hosted HSM custody by default."

jessica_legal: Add: "Key usage audit logs are available; customers may request cryptographic appendix for contractual terms. Key rotation and access control subject to agreed SLAs." Avoid promising additional certifications without legal review.

devin_se: Capability matrix snippet (we'll attach full CSV):
```
Feature,Hosted,Dedicated,Private
Text generation,Yes,Yes,Yes
Streaming,Yes,Yes,Yes
CMEK support,Partial,Yes,Yes
HSM-backed custody,No,Optional,Optional (on-prem)
Dedicated GPU pools,No,Yes,Yes
SLA-backed latency,No,Yes,Optional
```

maria_sales: POC pricing bullets? They want numbers to present to procurement.

devin_se: POC pricing proposal: $10,000 POC credit + Dedicated at 25% off list for up to 2 weeks (subject to availability). Production: reserved capacity pricing with monthly commit; example model: 2x A100-equivalent GPUs for sustained throughput = pricing model Y (we'll provide a sanitized scenario).

ashley_product: Rollout plan to include: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h; rollback if error rate > 1% or P95 latency exceeds SLO by >30% for 15m. Also include KV/prefix caching recommendations for latency-sensitive flows.

maria_sales: @jessica_legal any red flags in contract language re: data sovereignty or indemnities?

jessica_legal: Don't promise FedRAMP or similar unless product+contract supports it. Use: "Subject to contractual review; Private deployments can address data residency and compliance requirements." Attach standard compliance pack.

ops-bot: Attached files: rfp_sla.pdf, rfp_support_tiers.pdf, compliance_appendix.pdf :white_check_mark:

maria_sales: Final checklist for the single-response PDF I'll send: capability CSV (devin), KMS/HSM paragraph (ravi), POC schedule + pricing (devin), rollout SLO bullets (ashley), compliance blurb + appendix (jessica), SLA/support PDFs (ops-bot). Sending by 10:30am PT unless anything changes. :pray:
